title: Maya: An Instruction Finetuned Multilingual Multimodal Model

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance and accuracy on multimodal visual question answering and instruction-tuning benchmarks across multiple languages (e.g., using the PALO evaluation set) to address resource disparities and distribution biases between high-resource and low-resource languages.

Qualitatively evaluating the model's ability to accurately identify and describe culturally specific details in diverse images, such as regional cuisines and international landmarks, to measure understanding of varied cultural contexts.

Using automated safety-vetting frameworks like LLaVAGuard and Toxic-BERT to detect, categorize (e.g., hate speech, harassment), and filter out toxic and culturally insensitive content in the image-text pre-training dataset.
